Elgowainy, A., Reddi, K., Poudel, S., Tanveer, S. and Fang, Z. (2025). Hydrogen Delivery Scenario Analysis Model (HDSAM), Version 5.5 (Excel model; change history to 2025-06-24). Argonne National Laboratory. https://hdsam.es.anl.gov/

Locators are sheet names and cells of the workbook Hydrogen_Delivery_Scenario_Analysis_Model_(HDSAM)_V5.5.xlsm (28 sheets; two hidden). Version date taken from the title-sheet citation (2025) and change history (last entry 2025-06-24). This is a MODEL: values are default assumptions and cost correlations, not measured data. The workbook is saved without a scenario run, so most calculation cells hold #DIV/0! and no scenario outputs (levelized costs, energy per kg) were loaded; the one populated result (geologic storage, a 1,000 kg/day example) is a tiny sample scenario and was not loaded. Compressor energy per kg is not tabulated (the model computes it from the isentropic formula in Design Data B63-B85 and the inputs above). Derived rows (liquefier energy and capex at 10, 50 and 200 t/d; compressor $/kW at 1 and 10 MW; 12 in pipeline $/mile) evaluate printed correlations at extractor-chosen sizes, with the arithmetic in formula. Capital cost reference year defaults to 2022 for sheet entries; the correlations carry their own years (2007 compressors, 2012-2014 trailers and liquefier, 2019 pipeline and cavern). Refueling-station, terminal and precooling sheets (mobility) were not extracted. The .xlsm is kept with the extraction.

(1) Transmission pipeline hydrogen loss 300 kg/mile/yr in the pipeline sheet versus 778 in the Design Data table. (2) Liquefier energy cell text reads "13.382 * (Plant capacity) - 0.1" (exponent interpreted as -0.1). (3) Pipeline cost equations are labelled 2019 dollars and northeast regions but applied to a 2022 reference year. (4) LH2 trailer cost 950,000 is shown unescalated under a 2022$ header while the tractor is escalated.
